thread:
priya: Heads up — reproducing a weird role-merge when converting HF chat_template -> Redwood. Eval on llama2-13b-q4 caused system context to bleed into user messages.

matt: can you paste minimal repro? :eyes:

priya: here's the jinja we used:

```
{% if system %}
<|system|>{{ system | trim }}
{% endif %}
<|user|> {{ user | trim }}
```

priya: HF render produces (expected):

```
<|system|>System instructions

<|user|>User question
```

priya: but our converter emitted:

```
<|system|>System instructions<|user|>User question
```

sam: so newline removed between sentinels. That's bad — model sees it as one token stream, role demarcation lost.

alyssa: note that Jinja whitespace control like `{%-` or `-%}` and `trim` filters can remove the newline. We should treat any sentinel sequence as needing explicit separator.

matt: short-term fix: add `\\n` after sentinels in the conversion step. Example patch:

```
# when mapping chat_template -> prompt
prompt = re.sub(r"(<\\|system\\|>)(?!\\n)", r"\\1\\n", rendered)
```

priya: also found another problem: tokenizer config.json didn't register `<|system|>` and `<|user|>` as special tokens for some models, so token boundaries were wrong. That's why the merged string tokenized into unexpected tokens.

sam: test results: before fix run: rouge/f1 dropped ~3.8 points on convo QA set; after applying newline insertion and adding special tokens to tokenizer, metric recovered.

priya: opened ticket INF-4721 and attached minimal repro + eval logs. infra-bot: created INF-4721.

infra-bot: INF-4721: jinja delimiter trim -> role merge in HF->Redwood conversion created by priya

matt: plan: (1) add unit test in conversion tests to assert sentinel -> newline present (2) ensure conversion registers/validates special tokens from config.json (3) add migration doc for customers with custom chat_templates.

sam: i'll open a PR with tests and the regex patch, assign to eng-ml. :thumbsup:

priya: FYI watch out for templates that intentionally rely on trimming for formatting — we'll add a linter check to warn.

alyssa: thanks — this explains the quant eval regression we chased yesterday.

sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rw-engine/pull/2198

priya: merging once CI green. Thanks everyone.
